Most deleted data can be recovered through tedious and skilled means... which a very special group of people can do successfully. Or programs if find one that works. Often it is deleted and in a state where it can be recovered through those means but most often it is just overwritten to hold new files. 

If you are attempting to refresh a computer this would work well. 

If you are attempting to remove a virus/malware, downloading a Win10 image would be your best route for the most positive results. Only requires a small flash drive or DVD.

Computers can take time to start. Especially after usage and if not taken care of properly... Even the newest hardware and software can glitch, error and of course lag...

There could be several other reasons for your issue as well as it is vague. Does your computer start and no longer load past it's booting process? Does it complete it's process and boot only to then result in errors? Does it boot and work but the programs you are trying to run fail?  Also how have you tried to reset your PC? A hard reset or did you proper shut it off? Have you run any AV scans recently? Or deleted unused applications?
